title: Curtis Ramirez
description: Adds curtis from the curtoids series.
body:
This mod adds curtis from the Curtoids Series. I tried my best to make the recreation as faithful as possible.

 

To summon him, you must type in chat "i store chocolate in the shelf"

 

Curtis when summoned hunts you down, and hes invincible aswell. The only way to escape is to lock him up.

 

This mod REALLY improves your experience. It's EXTREMELY fun and ENTERTAINING. You will love this mod <3
